data.name: Humanoid (Halfling)
data.description: You gain a +%1 bonus on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks when using these skills against Halflings. Likewise, you get a +%1 bonus on weapon attack and damage rolls against such creatures. You may make Knowledge Skill checks untrained to identify such creatures.|FavoredHumanoidHalfling
